metadata.title: World Bank Remittance Prices Worldwide
metadata.scope: Five providers across ten common UK-origin corridors

analysis.question: Where do transfer costs vary most—and why?
analysis.scope: UK to 10 countries · $200 equivalent · Online · Within 3–5 days
findings: South Africa had the widest recorded provider spread: 5.79 percentage points, or about £6.95 on the comparable send amount.
India had the narrowest recorded spread among corridors with at least two comparable providers: 1.31 percentage points.
The most common classified source of the provider gap was fee difference; this is a diagnostic signal, not a causal claim.
